entries.description: Payment processing outage affecting multiple enterprise accounts; root cause traced to a failed certificate rotation. Resolved after ~4 hours.
Investigated elevated latency and slow response times reported by several accounts; root cause found to be a cache misconfiguration, fix deployed same day.
Umbrella Ltd contract is still pending legal review; redlines were sent back to their counsel and have not yet been returned.
Migrated internal documentation to the new wiki platform; no customer impact.
Rotated expiring SSL certificates across three internal services ahead of schedule.
Nightly backup job failed twice this week due to a storage quota issue; quota increased and job re-run successfully both times.
Added new alerting rules for database connection pool exhaustion.
